## Overview
Earthin is an ultra-fast, lightweight, and modern multipurpose WordPress theme built from scratch to comply 100% with the official WordPress Theme Review Team (TRT) directory submission requirements.

Serving as a high-performance alternative to Astra and GeneratePress, Earthin delivers sub-second load times and a total CSS/JS payload under 20KB with zero external runtime dependencies.

## Key Technical Features
1. **Performance First:** Under 20KB total assets, zero jQuery, pure vanilla JavaScript for navigation.
2. **Accessibility Ready:** Includes skip-to-content links, ARIA labels, semantic landmark elements, and full keyboard navigation.
3. **Earthin Ecosystem Integration:** Native support for Earthin Page Builder, Earthin Suite, and WooCommerce.
4. **Native Customizer:** Full live controls for Primary Accent Color, Container Max-Width, and Footer Copyright text.
5. **Standard Theme Layouts:** Complete template suite including `index.php`, `header.php`, `footer.php`, `single.php`, `page.php`, `archive.php`, `search.php`, `404.php`, `comments.php`, and `sidebar.php`.
